body: Yahoo Sports headlines frame Baker Mayfield's zero-completion performance against the Atlanta Falcons as "horrific" and "strange," suggesting a deeply negative reaction to his play. Sky Sports notes a "remarkable stat" for Mayfield but pairs it with the "implosion" of the Kansas City Chiefs, implying a mixed or critical tone regarding the broader game context. In contrast, the Tampa Bay Buccaneers organization and Mayfield himself expressed determination, with the team stating "Whatever It Takes to Win" during a press conference.
headline: Mixed reactions to Mayfield's historic no-pass loss
